subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: App Launch Time Testing
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on App Launch Time Testing.

hook.text: An app takes 8 seconds to launch. Studies show 25% of users abandon apps that take over 3 seconds to open.

buildup.text: Launch time is the first impression. Cold start, warm start, and hot start each have different benchmarks.

discovery.text: Cold start loads the app from scratch. Warm start resumes a cached process. Hot start brings a paused app forward.

twist.text: Low-end devices can have 3x slower launch times than flagships. Test the floor, not just the ceiling.

climax.text: Lazy loading and deferred initialization cut cold start time from 6 seconds to 1.5 seconds.

punchline.text: Three seconds to impress. Make launch time a test metric.

quiz.question: Why test on low-end devices for launch time?
options: They can be 3x slower and represent real user conditions
They cost less to test on
